meta.title: Learning at every age
meta.summary: Learning doesn’t end at one age or follow one neat route. Ohio’s schools and career programs connect classroom ideas with practical skills. Let’s see what you’d like to learn next.

sourceRefs.label: Ohio Department of Education and Workforce

blocks.text: Local school districts, career-technical programs, charter schools, and statewide education support are part of Ohio’s learning landscape. Different settings serve different communities and needs, and academic study and hands-on training can connect in many ways; no single diagram fits every learner.

The Ohio Department of Education and Workforce provides statewide information and resources. For a particular school or program, check its own offerings and requirements directly. Adult learning and career training open further paths too; choose what you want to learn next, then find the people and programs that can help you get there. I’d begin with what you want to learn and what your day can accommodate. There’s no single route I’d choose for everybody.
